name: I.NET.AU
summary: ISP on the i.net.au domain since at least Dec 1996 (dialup, ISDN and permanent accounts era; now NBN plans, ethernet/fibre, hosting and virtual machines). Present operator I.NET.AU Pty Ltd (ACN 092 417 804, incorporated 11 Apr 2000, Chadstone VIC), associated with PCM Computers Pty Ltd; continuity with the 1990s operator is plausible but unverified.

events.details: i.net.au live by 19 Dec 1996, hosting client sites; traded as iNET Technology in the late 1990s, providing internet access and hosting.
